$comment: Inputs Vitest imports cannot see (test revision stage A, 2026-10-24). Rules add to the import/literal-path graph; the first widen wins. Rule effects: widen (whole suite), none (declared test-free), tests (test globs), modules (treat the input as a change of these modules), run (npm scripts), keys (flat string catalog: narrow to tests naming a changed key, its previous text, or one of these whole-catalog markers). mirror: built output path prefix -> source prefix.

rules.reason: Vitest configuration, global setup, sequencer or reporter; dependencies, install, ignore or module-resolution settings: every test file runs through it

message catalog: a text edit selects the tests and fixtures that name the key or its previous text; an added or removed key also the code that names it; plus the whole-catalog checks (parity, plain Turkish, unused keys)
native shell helpers: their own native tests, plus the tests of the TypeScript modules that execute the built helpers
native peer-credential addon: its own native tests, plus the tests of the TypeScript modules that load it
host tooling, skills and agent rules: the host tests (rules parity included)
terminal palette generator input (regenerate with npm run build:terminal-tokens): the palette's tests
documentation and maintainer records: node scripts/lint-docs.mjs and node scripts/lint-arch.mjs check them; tests that read a file by path are still selected
hosted CI definition: proven by the hosted run on the pushed head
lint configuration: run eslint on the changed files
separate latency lane, never in the default suite: VITEST_MAX_FORKS=1 npx vitest run --config tests/perf/vitest.config.ts
